Increased pressure.
In the US we have an organization called SAAMI which handles the standardization of specs for cartridges, and the +P designation signifies a higher maximum operating pressure over the cartridge standard.
For example:
9x19 has a pmax of 35,000psi.
9x19 +P however has a higher pmax of 38,500psi.
The higher working pressure allows powder to burn faster so you extrapolate more energy from it in a given span of barrel.
